goalZh: 会在语音信箱里留一条清楚的消息,并在回电时商量改时间
canDoZh: 能在语音信箱里留一条清楚的消息,并在回电时商量改到另一个时间

newItems.noteZh: w 不发音,读 /ˈænsɚ/;He isn't answering. 他没接电话。
v 是上齿轻碰下唇,别读成 w;It goes to voicemail. 转到语音信箱了。
重音在前 MES-sage,ss 读 /s/,ge 读 /dʒ/;a text message 一条短信。
Please leave a message. 请留言;leave 是长元音 /iː/,别读成 live /lɪv/。
Call me back. 给我回电话;宾语是代词时放中间:call me back,不说 call back me。
Can we play on Sunday instead? 改到周日行吗?instead 一般放在句末;重音在后 in-STEAD,ea 读 /e/。
I hope it's OK. 希望没问题;h 只是从喉咙轻轻呼气,嘴唇不碰牙齿,别读成 f。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: (劳拉临时请磊周六去店里帮忙,磊赶紧给伊森打电话,响了半天没人接)哦,转到语音信箱了。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Hey, it's Ethan. Leave a message!
lines.zh: (伊森的语音提示)嘿,我是伊森。请留言!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi, Ethan. It's Lei. Sorry, I can't play on Saturday.
lines.zh: 嗨,伊森,我是磊。抱歉,周六我不能去打球了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have to work. Laura needs me at the cafe.
lines.zh: 我得上班,劳拉要我去店里帮忙。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Can we play on Sunday instead? Call me back. Thanks!
lines.zh: 能不能改到周日打?给我回个电话。谢谢!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Hey, man! It's Ethan. Thanks for the message.
lines.zh: (晚上伊森回电话)嘿,哥们儿!我是伊森。留言收到了,谢啦。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sorry, I never answer at the gym. Sunday is good!
lines.zh: 抱歉,我在健身房从来不接电话。周日可以!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Great! How about ten in the morning?
lines.zh: 太好了!上午十点怎么样?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Ten? That's really early for me, man!
lines.zh: 十点?对我来说也太早了吧,哥们儿!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sorry! I hope it's OK. I have to study in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 不好意思!希望你能行。我下午得学习。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: OK, OK. Ten o'clock at the gym.
lines.zh: 好吧好吧。十点,健身房见。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Cool. Sunday at ten is good. See you!
lines.zh: 好嘞。周日十点没问题。回头见!

questions.prompt: 磊为什么周六不能去打球?
questions.explainZh: 磊在留言里说 I have to work. Laura needs me at the cafe.(我得上班,劳拉要我去店里帮忙。)

questions.prompt: 磊在留言里请伊森做什么?
questions.explainZh: 留言最后一句:Call me back. Thanks!(给我回个电话。谢谢!)

questions.prompt: 他们最后约在什么时候?
questions.explainZh: 磊提议 How about ten in the morning?,伊森说 Ten o'clock at the gym.,磊确认 Sunday at ten is good.(周日十点没问题。)

grammar.bodyZh: 打电话没人接,会转到语音信箱(voicemail)。听到 Leave a message!(请留言)以后,按这个顺序说:① 问候、自报姓名:Hi, Ethan. It's Lei.(电话里说“我是……”用 It's… 或 This is…,不说 I am Lei.)② 什么事:Sorry, I can't play on Saturday. I have to work. ③ 想怎么办:Can we play on Sunday instead? ④ 请对方回电:Call me back. Thanks!。留言要短,时间、地点说清楚。call back 的宾语是代词时放中间:call me back,不说 call back me。

examples.text: Sorry, I can't come on Saturday. I have to work.
examples.zh: 抱歉,我周六来不了,我得上班。
给我回个电话,好吗?谢谢!

grammar.titleZh: 改约:…instead? / Is … OK?;h 和 f 分清楚
grammar.bodyZh: 想换个时间,说 Can we … instead?(能不能改成……?),instead 放在句末:Can we play on Sunday instead?。也可以直接问 Is Sunday OK? 或 How about ten in the morning?。答应时说 Sunday at ten is good.(周日十点可以。)客气一点再加一句 I hope it's OK.(希望你没问题。)发音:have、hope、how 的 h 只是从喉咙轻轻呼气,嘴唇不碰牙齿;fun、free、five 的 f 是上齿轻碰下唇。四川口音容易把这两个音混读,读 hope 时注意别让嘴唇碰到牙齿。

examples.text: Can we play on Sunday instead?
Is Sunday OK? — Sunday at ten is good.
examples.zh: 周日行吗?——周日十点可以。

examples.text: I hope it's OK. Have fun!
